market.what: fluoride control in black-mass hydromet: leach defluorination (Ca/Al salts, Zr sorbents) + F-driven heat treatment, world
market.method: est.: ~$40/t x 600 kt BM leach defluorination ($24M) + heat treatment $200-500/t on ~150 kt BM that must reach <=0.4% water-soluble F ($52M)

value.logic: per t BM: ~$40 less Li lost as LiF + ~$20 less Ca-salt sludge + skip part of F roasting -> ~$100/t x 600 kt, haircut to $60M
value.revenue_logic: $60M x 2.66 (2032) x 10% adoption x 35% capture as sorbent sales
value.margin_logic: inorganic/Zr-type sorbent; Chinese Zr resins cap price

trend.drivers: black mass growth; China 'fluoride wall' on imports; overseas intermediate processing; LFP leach also needs F removal
trend.deadline: China GB/T 45203-2024 (in force mid-2025): water-soluble F <=0.1-0.4% in imported black mass

incumbents: Sunresin (Zr-loaded F-removal resin for LIB recycling)
competition.notes: La-Zr sorbents reach <5 mg/L F (Ca route ~20 mg/L) with little Li/Ni/Co uptake; Sunresin already sells Zr resin

lab.synth: 1-2 step inorganic/Zr-La or Zr-MOF sorbent, cheap precursors, 3 variants
lab.test: F isotherms in real leach pH 2-5 by ion-selective electrode/ion chromatography (EPA 300.0), Li/Ni/Co uptake by ICP-OES, 5 regeneration cycles
lab.logic: synth 4-6 wk ~$8k; test 4 wk ~200 F + ICP analyses x $30-50 + leach ~$5k

sale.gates: plant-liquor bench 3 mo; 6-12 mo side-stream trial; Li2CO3 F spec check
